climate: Shiraz and Cabernet Sauvignon sit in their sweet spot, so the wines can show the style they are known for.
A dry climate, though much of its little rain falls while the vines grow. Water is scarce.

blurb.text: A region in South Australia's Fleurieu area, on the plains along the lower Bremer and Angas Rivers, reaching Lake Alexandrina. Shiraz is 39 percent of plantings and Cabernet Sauvignon 33 percent.
